title: Design: Categories page shows a notice while Internal Work Orders is off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow0-08-2e-internal-work-orders-page-setting-off.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A notice at the top reads "Internal Work Orders is off. Turn it on in Settings > Work Orders."
  • Both tabs, their tables, the New Internal Category and New No Charge Category buttons and the row menus stay usable (the lists are editable).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R13: “The page needs 'Settings — Service', like every Administration > Service page; while the setting is off it shows the notice "Internal Work Orders is off. Turn it on in Settings > Work Orders." and the lists stay editable.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: page "Flow 0 · Turn it on", board "2e Internal Work Orders page · setting off" (Flow 0 · Turn it on).
